description: Full-text search over Moroccan legislation articles (and texts by number or title, e.g. "65.99" or "مدونة الشغل"). Returns article snippets with URLs. With lang=fr it also returns `other_language`: laws that exist only in Arabic and that the query names (by number or by a French name such as "code de la route"); their `title` is the official Arabic title.

kind.description: loi, decret, dahir, dahir-loi, arrete, constitution

lang.description: Language of the text: "ar" (Arabic, most texts) or "fr" (French translation, when published).

name: search_law
title: Search Moroccan law
